title: About DarGlobal - Luxury International Real Estate Developer
text: DarGlobal PLC is an internationally renowned luxury real estate developer listed on the London Stock Exchange (LSE: DAR). Established in 2017 as the international arm of Dar Al Arkan (one of Saudi Arabia's largest real estate developers), DarGlobal focuses on creating second homes and prime vacation residences in high-end global destinations. The company operates across prime markets including the United Arab Emirates (Dubai), United Kingdom (London), Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, Sultanate of Oman, Qatar, Spain (Costa del Sol), and Bosnia. DarGlobal differentiates itself by partnering with global luxury brands in automotive, fashion, and hospitality to deliver branded residences.

title: DarGlobal Investor Relations and Financial Overview
text: DarGlobal PLC is traded on the Main Market of the London Stock Exchange under ticker DAR. The company's portfolio spans over $5.9 billion in Gross Development Value (GDV) across more than 10 countries. DarGlobal's business model emphasizes capital efficiency, partnering with tier-one luxury lifestyle brands, high-profile co-investors, and master developers. Target clientele comprises international high-net-worth individuals (HNWIs) seeking portfolio diversification, premium capital appreciation, high rental yields, and residency through investment (such as the UAE Golden Visa and Spanish Golden Visa).

title: DarGlobal Brand Partnerships - Luxury Co-Branding
text: A cornerstone of DarGlobal's global strategy is collaborating with iconic luxury marques. Notable brand collaborations include: Automobili Lamborghini for exclusive villas; Pagani Automobili for hypercar-inspired bespoke residential towers; Missoni for vibrant Italian haute couture interiors; Elie Saab for haute couture waterfront residences; W Hotels (Marriott International) for lifestyle hospitality residences; Aston Martin for bespoke architectural design; and The Trump Organization for world-class luxury golf resorts and residential villas.

title: Urban Oasis by Missoni - Business Bay, Dubai Canal
text: Urban Oasis by Missoni is a flagship 34-storey residential waterfront tower situated along the Dubai Water Canal in Business Bay, Dubai. Designed with interiors curated by the iconic Italian fashion house Missoni, the development offers studios, 1-bedroom, 2-bedroom, 3-bedroom apartments, and exclusive 4-bedroom penthouses with private elevator access. Amenities include an infinity pool overlooking the canal, state-of-the-art gymnasium, private canal-side boardwalk access, 24/7 concierge, and bespoke Missoni Home furnishings. The project is strategically positioned 5 minutes from Downtown Dubai, Burj Khalifa, and Dubai Mall.

title: DaVinci Tower by Pagani - Downtown Dubai Canal
text: DaVinci Tower (Pagani Tower) is a landmark ultra-luxury residential skyscraper located on the Dubai Canal directly opposite Burj Khalifa. Created in collaboration with Pagani Automobili, the architecture and interiors draw inspiration from Horacio Pagani's legendary hypercars (Zonda and Huayra). Featuring carbon fiber finishes, kinetic chandeliers, bespoke Italian leather craftsmanship, and aerodynamic curves, the tower hosts 2 to 4-bedroom residences and an exclusive duplex penthouse. Residences feature private plunge pools, panoramic skyline vistas, rooftop infinity pool, spa, and dedicated white-glove concierge services.

title: W Residences Dubai - Downtown
text: W Residences Dubai - Downtown is an elite 49-storey residential development located in the heart of Downtown Dubai, managed by Marriott International under the W Hotels brand. The tower offers 384 branded residences ranging from 1 to 3 bedrooms and exclusive duplex penthouses. Residents enjoy signature W services ('Whatever/Whenever' concierge), private media room, coworking lounge (the Clubhouse), infinity-edge swimming pool overlooking Burj Khalifa, state-of-the-art FIT gym, and VIP access to Marriott Bonvoy status perks worldwide.

title: DG1 Living - Business Bay Waterfront, Dubai
text: DG1 Living is an architectural marvel situated in Business Bay on the Dubai Canal. Designed by world-renowned architecture firm Gensler, DG1 features a distinctive sculpted facade with dynamic twisting balconies that optimize canal and city views. The development comprises 1, 2, and 3-bedroom luxury waterfront apartments equipped with European designer kitchens, high ceilings, floor-to-ceiling soundproof glazing, sky gardens, infinity pool deck, gym, and retail promenade.

title: AIDA - Seafront Master Development in Muscat, Oman
text: AIDA is a monumental $4 billion gated master-planned community and mixed-use luxury golf resort perched 130 meters atop ocean cliffs in Yiti and Yenkit, Muscat, Oman. Developed in joint venture with Omran (the Sultanate of Oman's executive arm for tourism development), AIDA spans over 3.5 million square meters. The project includes Trump International Golf Club Oman (an 18-hole championship golf course designed to host international tournaments), Trump Cliff Villas, luxury hotel resort, cliff-edge wellness center, promenade, Michelin-starred dining, and private beaches with freehold ownership for all nationalities.

title: Trump International Resort and Golf Club - AIDA, Oman
text: Trump International Resort, Golf Club & Residences at AIDA, Muscat represents a landmark collaboration between DarGlobal and The Trump Organization. The development features an elite luxury Trump hotel, private gated estate villas, golf-course view villas, cliffside penthouses, member-exclusive clubhouse, private equestrian trails, and wellness retreats. Foreign purchasers at AIDA qualify for Oman's Investor Residency visa, enabling long-term residency in the Sultanate.

title: Les Vagues by Elie Saab - Qetaifan Island North, Qatar
text: Les Vagues by Elie Saab is the first branded residential project in Qatar by world-renowned fashion designer Elie Saab. Located on the pristine shores of Qetaifan Island North (Lusail, Qatar), Les Vagues offers premium 1, 2, and 3-bedroom sea-facing apartments with sweeping Arabian Gulf horizons. The residences feature floor-to-ceiling glass, spacious seaside balconies, curated Elie Saab Maison interiors, private beach access, infinity pool, fitness center, and marina promenade.

title: Tierra Viva by Automobili Lamborghini - Benahavis, Spain
text: Tierra Viva is an exclusive architectural enclave of 53 ultra-luxury multi-level villas perched in the prestigious hills of Benahavis, near Marbella on Spain's Costa del Sol. Designed in collaboration with Automobili Lamborghini, the villas feature sharp, aggressive lines inspired by Lamborghini supercars. Available in three distinct villa typologies: Diamante (6 bedrooms), Zafiro (5 bedrooms), and Esmeralda (4 bedrooms). All villas boast private infinity swimming pools, expansive rooftop terraces, wine cellars, home theaters, SPA facilities, and 24/7 gated security with panoramic Mediterranean views.

title: Marea, Interiors by Missoni - Finca Cortesin, Casares, Spain
text: Marea by Missoni is an elite gated residential community located within the world-renowned Finca Cortesin resort in Casares, Costa del Sol, Spain. Overlooking the championship golf course and the Mediterranean Sea, Marea offers 2, 3, and 4-bedroom residences designed with signature Missoni patterns and finishes. Residents enjoy access to tennis and padel courts, the Finca Cortesin Beach Club, Michelin-star restaurants, private infinity pool, and wellness spa.

title: The Astwood - South Kensington, London, UK
text: The Astwood by DarGlobal is an exquisite boutique collection of luxury period residences situated in South Kensington, one of London's most desirable royal boroughs. Preserving Victorian heritage facades while integrating state-of-the-art contemporary luxury interiors, The Astwood offers opulent 1 to 3-bedroom apartments and penthouses. Situated minutes from Harrods, the Victoria & Albert Museum, Hyde Park, and King's Road Chelsea.

title: DarGlobal Real Estate Investment & Golden Visa Eligibility
text: Purchasing property with DarGlobal in Dubai (such as Urban Oasis, DaVinci Tower, W Residences) enables foreign investors to qualify for the 10-year renewable UAE Golden Visa when investing AED 2,000,000 ($545,000 USD) or more. DarGlobal offers flexible multi-year construction-linked payment plans (e.g., 20% down payment, 50% during construction, 30% upon completion or handover). In Oman (AIDA), property purchases confer permanent residency rights for buyers and their direct families. In Spain (Tierra Viva, Marea), investments over €500,000 qualify for the Spanish Golden Visa program.

title: About Wasalt - Premier Saudi Real Estate Platform
text: Wasalt (وصلت) is the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia's premier real estate technology and marketplace platform. Backed by Quara Holding and established in strategic partnership with Dar Al Arkan, Wasalt provides a trusted, comprehensive digital ecosystem for buying, selling, and renting residential and commercial properties across Saudi Arabia. Wasalt combines verified listings, interactive masterplans, digital mortgage calculators, and direct developer partnerships to modernize real estate transactions in line with Saudi Vision 2030.

title: Wasalt Licensing and REGA FAL Compliance
text: Wasalt operates in full compliance with the Real Estate General Authority (REGA / الهيئة العامة للعقار) of Saudi Arabia. All listings on Wasalt require and display a verified Fal Brokerage and Marketing License (رخصة فال العقارية) and an official Advertising License number. Wasalt connects seamlessly with Saudi government proptech services, including the National Housing Company (NHC), Ejar (إيجار) tenancy verification platform, and the Wafi (وافي) off-plan sales licensing commission.

title: Wasalt Business - Broker & Developer Real Estate Solutions
text: Wasalt Business is the dedicated enterprise suite providing real estate brokers, certified agencies, and property developers across Saudi Arabia with sophisticated CRM tools, listing syndication, digital marketing analytics, lead management, and certified property valuation services. Through Wasalt Business, developers can showcase mega-projects, masterplans, and off-plan residential communities directly to verified Saudi citizens and foreign investors.

title: Wasalt Electronic Real Estate Auctions
text: Wasalt Auctions (مزادات وصلت) is an authorized digital platform for public and judicial real estate auctions across Saudi Arabia. Conducting transparent bidding on commercial plots, agricultural lands, residential buildings, and distressed assets under regulatory supervision, Wasalt Auctions allows pre-qualified bidders to participate online using authorized bank guarantees and digital identity authentication (Absher/Nafath).

title: Villas for Sale in Al Malqa, North Riyadh - Wasalt Listings
text: Al Malqa is one of North Riyadh's most prestigious and sought-after residential neighborhoods, located along King Salman Road and Anas Ibn Malik Road. Current Wasalt listings in Al Malqa feature modern smart luxury villas: Plot sizes range from 350 sqm to 750 sqm, priced between SAR 3,800,000 to SAR 8,500,000. Typical specs: 5 master bedrooms, private elevator, swimming pool, driver and maid quarters, landscaped courtyard, and double-height living halls. Close to KAFD (King Abdullah Financial District) and Boulevard Riyadh.

title: Apartments for Sale in Al Narjis, North Riyadh - Wasalt
text: Al Narjis district in North Riyadh represents a premier high-growth real estate corridor near Princess Nourah University and King Khalid International Airport. Wasalt features modern 3-bedroom luxury apartments ranging from 130 sqm to 185 sqm, priced between SAR 850,000 and SAR 1,450,000. Features include underground private parking, smart home automation, built-in air conditioning, rooftop terraces, and 10-year structural building warranties compliant with the Saudi Building Code.

title: Furnished and Unfurnished Apartments for Rent in Al Olaya, Riyadh
text: Al Olaya is Riyadh's central commercial and business core, housing Kingdom Centre, Al Faisaliah Tower, and major financial headquarters. Wasalt offers executive apartments for rent: 1-bedroom executive suites and 2-3 bedroom residential apartments. Annual rentals range from SAR 55,000 to SAR 120,000 depending on furnishing status and building amenities (gym, 24/7 security, swimming pool, reception). Ideal for professionals working in central Riyadh.

title: Villas and Gated Communities in Al Nakheel, West Riyadh
text: Al Nakheel is an established high-end residential neighborhood adjacent to King Saud University and Digital City. Wasalt showcases standalone mansions and gated compound villas starting from SAR 5,500,000 up to SAR 16,000,000. Properties boast sprawling floor plans (500-1200 sqm), private cinema rooms, central climate control, mature private gardens, and proximity to diplomatic and executive hubs.

title: Luxury Designer Villas for Sale in Hittin, Riyadh
text: Hittin is arguably Riyadh's top luxury lifestyle address, situated next to Diriyah Gate and Boulevard City. Wasalt listings in Hittin include contemporary architectural villas with internal courtyards, basement entertainment lounges, marble finishes, and German kitchen appliances. Prices range from SAR 6,000,000 to SAR 14,000,000 for 400 sqm to 900 sqm properties.

title: Sea-View Apartments for Sale in Al Shati, Jeddah Corniche
text: Al Shati is Jeddah's prime coastal neighborhood along the North Corniche, overlooking the Red Sea. Wasalt features luxury seafront apartments in high-rise towers: 2 to 4-bedroom apartments offering direct Red Sea views, private beach access, concierge service, infinity swimming pools, and private fitness health clubs. Sale prices range from SAR 1,600,000 to SAR 4,200,000.

title: Waterfront Villas and Compounds in Obhur Al Shamaliyah, Jeddah
text: Obhur Al Shamaliyah (North Obhur) is Jeddah's premier maritime and boating residential district, centered around Sharm Obhur. Wasalt listings highlight private waterfront villas and modern compound residences with boat slips, private jetties, and gardens. Prices range from SAR 2,200,000 for semi-detached townhouses up to SAR 9,000,000 for direct sea-access estates.

title: Apartments and Offices for Rent in Al Hamra, Jeddah
text: Al Hamra district is famous for its cultural presence, diplomatic missions, and proximity to King Fahd's Fountain. Wasalt lists executive commercial office spaces and residential rental apartments ranging from SAR 45,000 to SAR 95,000 annually, with convenient access to Palestine Street and Andalusia Road.

title: Luxury Real Estate in Al Khobar - Corniche, Al Dana & Al Hizam
text: Al Khobar in the Eastern Province is the corporate hub for energy and maritime commerce, closely linked to the King Fahd Causeway to Bahrain. Wasalt showcases luxury duplexes and independent villas in Al Khobar Corniche, Al Dana, and Al Hizam Al Thahabi. Prices range from SAR 2,100,000 to SAR 5,500,000 with community parks, international school proximity, and Gulf coastline access.

title: Residential and Commercial Land Plots for Sale in Dammam
text: Wasalt offers verified residential and investment commercial land plots across Dammam (Al Fursan, Al Shatea, Al Noor). Land plots range from 400 sqm for single-family residential construction to 3,000+ sqm for multi-family apartment buildings, with ready utility infrastructure (water, electricity, fiber optics) and clear title deeds (Sukuk) verified through the Ministry of Justice.

title: Real Estate Financing and Mortgage Calculator on Wasalt
text: Wasalt offers an integrated digital mortgage calculator enabling Saudi buyers to evaluate financing options compliant with Islamic Sharia principles (Murabaha and Ijara). Partnered with leading Saudi banks including Al Rajhi Bank, SNB (Saudi National Bank), Riyad Bank, and Bank Albilad, Wasalt facilitates subsidized home loans under the Sakani (سكني) housing initiative for eligible Saudi citizens.

title: Foreign Real Estate Ownership Rules in Saudi Arabia
text: Under updated Saudi Arabian regulatory frameworks and the Premium Residency (الإقامة المميزة) initiative, non-Saudi residents and foreign investors are permitted to own real estate for residential and commercial purposes in designated areas across the Kingdom. Properties listed on Wasalt provide full legal documentation, Fal licensing compliance, and clear ownership transfers through authorized notary portals.

title: DarGlobal vs Wasalt: Relationship to Dar Al Arkan and Sister Ecosystem
text: Both DarGlobal and Wasalt share deep strategic roots with Dar Al Arkan Real Estate Development Company (Saudi Arabia's premier publicly traded real estate giant). DarGlobal is the international luxury development arm (listed in London), focusing on creating high-end branded residential developments in Dubai, London, Oman, Spain, and Qatar. Wasalt, on the other hand, is the premier domestic Saudi proptech marketplace and brokerage platform, connecting buyers, tenants, brokers, and developers across Riyadh, Jeddah, Dammam, and beyond.
